title: Kate's Hat Shop
synopsis: Kate tries hats on a watering can, a pumpkin, a fence post, and eventually a very fashionable mouse.

related_resources.reason: Broad contextual discussion of pretend play and shared amusement, not a study of the story.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: The watering can looked like it was going to a party.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: The visual joke is deliberately whimsical, without an assigned lesson.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: General play guidance only. No inference that a hat shop causes a particular developmental outcome.

source_note: Original fictional story. Parent-facing references provide context for age-appropriate playful interaction, not direct evidence about this plot or any measured developmental outcome.
